qe: Which law explains the 'Curvature of Light' around a massive object?
qh: कौन सा नियम किसी विशाल वस्तु के चारों ओर 'प्रकाश के झुकाव' की व्याख्या करता है?
e: Concept: Newton ke law me gravitation ek 'force' hai jo do vastuon ko kheenchti hai, par roshni (light) par force ka asar kam dikhta hai. Einstein ki General Relativity kehti hai ki bhaari vastu (jaise Suraj) apne aas-paas ki space-time ko mud (curve) deti hai, aur roshni us mudey hue raste par chal-ne ke kaaran mud jaati hai - isko 'gravitational lensing' bhi kehte hain. Yisa asar 1919 ke solar eclipse me saabit hua tha. Snell's law refraction ke liye hai, Ohm's law current ke liye. Exam point: 'Ros hni ka mudna bhaari vastu ke paas = General Relativity (space-time curvature)'.

Concept: Wave do kism ki hoti hain - transverse (jismein kampan wave ki chalne ki disha ke lambavat hota hai, jaise roshni) aur longitudinal (jismein kampan wave ki disha ke saath-saath aage-peeche hota hai, jaise spring ko dabana). Sound hawa me dabav ki sookshm chhoti-chhoti compression aur rarefaction (khas-khas) ke roop me chalta hai, isliye wo longitudinal hai. Sound ko chalne ke liye medium chahiye (vacuum me nahi chalta), jabki electromagnetic waves (roshni, microwave) medium ke bina chal sakti hain. Exam point: 'Sound = longitudinal (mechanical) wave'.

qe: Which mirror is used by dentists to see enlarged images of teeth?
qh: दंत चिकित्सकों द्वारा दांतों की बड़ी छवि देखने के लिए किस दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Dentist ko daant ka bada (enlarged) aur seedha pratibimb chahiye hota hai. Concave (andar ki taraf mudda) mirror: jab object mirror ke focus ke andar rakha ho, to uska seedha, bada aur virtual image banta hai - isliye mirror me daant bade dikhte hain. Convex mirror hamesha chhota image deta hai (isliye gaadi ke side mirror me zyada area dikhta hai), plane mirror asli size ka deta hai. Exam point: 'Bada-seedha image = concave mirror (focus ke andar object)'.

qh: ध्वनि की गति सबसे तीव्र किसमें होती है?
e: Concept: Sound ek mechanical wave hai jo medium ke kanon ko aage-peeche dhakel kar chalti hai. Jitna sakht (rigid) aur elastic medium ho, utni tezi se kampan aage pahunchta hai. Isliye speed solids (steel ~5000-6000 m/s) me sabse zyada, usse kam liquids (paani ~1500 m/s) me aur sabse kam gases (hawa ~343 m/s) me hoti hai; vacuum me to sound chalta hi nahi. Isliye steel wale option me sound sabse tez chalta hai. Exam point: 'Sound ki speed: Solid > Liquid > Gas (vacuum me zero)'.

qh: निकट दृष्टि दोष को किसका उपयोग करके ठीक किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Myopia (near-sightedness) me aankh ke lens ki focusing power zyada ho jaati hai, isliye paas ki cheezein to saaf dikhti hain par door ki cheezein retina ke thoda aage banti hain - matlab door ka image blur. Isko theek karne ke liye aisi lens chahiye jo roshni ko thoda phaila (diverge) de, aur wo kaam concave (avatal) lens karta hai jo negative power ka hota hai. Convex lens aur bhi focus badha dega, jo galat hai. Hypermetropia (door-drishti) me convex lens lagta hai. Exam point: 'Myopia = concave (avatal) lens'.

qe: Which layer of the Sun is visible during a total solar eclipse?
qh: पूर्ण सूर्य ग्रहण के दौरान सूर्य की कौन-सी परत दिखाई देती है?
e: Concept: Surya ki teen parat hoti hain - photosphere (jo hum roz dekhte hain), chromosphere (photosphere ke upar, laal rang) aur corona (sabse bahar ki patli, bahut garam par kam roshni wali parat). Aam roshni me photosphere ki chamak ke aage corona dikhta nahi, par jab poora soorya chand ke peeche chhup jata hai (total solar eclipse), aas-paas ka aasmaan peela-lag kar corona ka noor dikhne lagta hai. Isi liye corona eclipse ke waqt dikhta hai. Exam point: 'Total solar eclipse me corona dikhta hai'.

qe: What is the escape velocity of Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी का पलायन वेग (escape velocity) क्या है?
e: Concept: Escape velocity wo kam se kam raftaar hai jisse koi vastu (rocket, gas ka anu) kisi grah ke gravity se hamesha ke liye nikal jaaye - uske baad use wapas kheench kar laane wala koi force nahi bachta. Prithvi ke liye ye value lagbhag 11.2 km/s hai (yeh ghumne ki raftaar se alag hai, jo 7.9 km/s hoti hai). Isi liye rocket ko 11.2 km/s se zyada speed chahiye. 9.8 gravitation ka acceleration hai, km/s nahi. Exam point: 'Earth ki escape velocity = 11.2 km/s'.

qe: What is the SI unit of 'Power'?
e: Concept: Power matlab energy kharch karne ki raftaar (P = W/t). Iska SI unit watt hai, jahan 1 watt = 1 joule/1 second. Bulb, heater, motor - sab ki rating watt me likhi hoti hai (jaise 100 W bulb). Joule energy ka unit hai, newton force ka, pascal pressure ka. Isliye 'power ka SI unit watt' yaad rakho. Exam point: 'Power = watt (1 W = 1 J/s); energy = joule'. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Watt (vat) hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Luminous Intensity?
qh: ज्योति तीव्रता (Luminous Intensity) का 'SI मात्रक' क्या है?
e: Concept: Luminous intensity ka matlab hai kisi source se khaas disha me kitni roshni nikalti hai (kaise tez). Iska SI unit candela (cd) hai. Aam bolchal me 1 candela lagbhag ek mombatti ki roshni jaisi maani jaati hai (isliye purane ghar me 'candle power' bolte the). Mole padarth ki maatra ka unit hai, Kelvin temperature ka, ampere current ka. Exam point: 'Luminous intensity = candela (cd)'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Candela (kaindela) sahi hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: What is the SI unit of Electric Current?
qh: विद्युत धारा का SI मात्रक क्या है?
e: Concept: Electric current ka matlab hai charge ka behta paani, yaani kitne coulomb charge har second guzarte hain (I = Q/t). Iska SI unit ampere (A) hai; 1 ampere = 1 coulomb/1 second. Ghar ke fuse, MCB, bulb sab ampere me naape jate hain. Volt potential difference ka unit hai, ohm resistance ka, watt power ka. Exam point: 'Current = ampere (1 A = 1 C/s)'. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Ampere (empiyar) hi theek uttar hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: In commercial paper products, what is 'GSM' used for?
qh: व्यावसायिक कागज उत्पादों में 'जीएसएम' (GSM) का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Concept: GSM ka poora matlab 'Grams per Square Metre' hai - ye batata hai ki kagaz ke 1 square metre ka wajan kitne gram hai. Paper industry me isi se kagaz ki motai aur bhaar tay hota hai (jaise 70-80 GSM aam likhne ka kagaz, 100+ GSM visiting card, 250+ GSM cover). Isliye GSM kagaz ki mohtai/wajan ka paimana hai, rang ya keemat nahi. Exam point: 'GSM = grams per square metre (kagaz ki motai/weight)'. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Thickness/Weight | motai/vajan sahi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which unit is used to measure the thickness of paper?
qh: कागज की मोटाई मापने के लिए किस इकाई का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Kagaz ki motai ko aamtaur par seedha naapa nahi jata, balki uske bhaar se naapa jata hai - isi ke liye 'GSM' (grams per square metre) unit use hota hai. Micron aur nanometer bahut chhote units hain (plastic film, fibre ke liye), par kagaz ke liye industry ka standard GSM hai. 1 GSM matlab us paper ke 1 sq metre ka weight 1 gram. Isliye kis paper par print hoga, wo GSM se tay hota hai. Exam point: 'Paper ki motai ka unit = GSM'.

qe: Which mirror is used in 'Solar Cookers'?
qh: 'सोलर कुकर' में किस दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Solar cooker me sooraj ki kiranein ek bade reflector par padti hain, aur unhe ek chhote se bindu (focus) par jama karna hota hai jahan khana rakha container rakha hota hai - kyunki wahi energy jama hone se temperature bahut badhta hai. Kiranein jama karne ka kaam concave (avatal) mirror karta hai (jaise TV dish antenna). Plane mirror sirf reflect karta hai, convex mirror kiranein faila deta hai (ulta kaam). Isliye solar cooker me concave mirror hota hai. Exam point: 'Solar cooker/headlight/shaiving mirror = concave mirror'.

qe: Which type of mirror is used in 'Headlights' of cars?
qh: कारों की 'हेडलाइट्स' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Car headlight me bulb ko concave (avatal) mirror ke focus par rakha jata hai. Focus par rakhi roshni ki kiranein reflect hokar samantar (parallel) beam ban jaati hain, isliye wo door tak ek seedhi tez beam ki tarah jaati hai. Agar convex mirror lagta to beam faila kar kamzor ho jaata (wo side mirror me use hota hai). Yahi wajah hai ki headlight ka light door tak pahunchta hai. Exam point: 'Headlight = concave mirror (light ko parallel beam banana)'.

qe: Which part of the eye controls the amount of light entering it?
qh: आँख का कौन सा भाग उसमें प्रवेश करने वाली रोशनी की मात्रा को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Concept: Aankh me roshni cornea aur lens se guzar kar retina par image banati hai. Roshni ki maatra (kam-zyada) ko iris control karta hai - ye wahi rang wala ring hai jo aankh ka 'black' hissa lagta hai. Iris ke beech me chhota hole pupil hota hai: tez roshni me iris pupil ko chhota kar deta hai (kam roshni andar), andhere me bada kar deta hai. Retina par image banti hai aur lens focusing karta hai. Exam point: 'Roshni ki maatra = iris (pupil ke size se)'.

qe: What is the 'Critical Angle' for Total Internal Reflection to occur?
qh: पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन के लिए 'क्रांतिक कोण' क्या है?
e: Concept: Jab roshni saande (denser) medium se halke (rarer) medium me jaati hai (jaise paani se hawa me), to wo normal se door mudti hai. Jaisa aap angle badhate hain, apvartan (refraction) angle bhi badhta hai; ek khaas angle par wartan angle theek 90 degree ho jata hai - matlab refracted kirane medium ke saath-soorakh (surface) par chalti hai. Usi angle ko 'critical angle' kehte hain. Isse zyada angle par roshni wapas usi medium me mud jati hai - isi ko poorn antarik paravartan (total internal reflection) kehte hain. Exam point: 'Critical angle = jab apvartan kon 90 degree ho jaye'.

qe: What is the refractive index of 'Diamond'?
e: Concept: Kisi medium ka refractive index batata hai ki roshni us medium me kitni dheemi ho jaati hai (ya kitna mudti hai). Heera (diamond) ki value 2.42 hai - sabse zyada ke qareeb, isliye roshni heere ke andar baar-baar poori tarah reflect hoti hai aur wo chamakta hai (total internal reflection + fire). Paani ki roughly 1.33, kaanch ki 1.5 hoti hai, aur khaali jagah/hawa ki 1.00. Exam point: 'Diamond ka refractive index = 2.42 (sabse zyada)'.

qe: What is the S.I. unit of Power of Lens?
qh: लेंस की क्षमता का S.I. मात्रक क्या है?
e: Concept: Lens ki power batati hai ki lens roshni ko kitna modta hai - jitna chhota focal length (focus ki doori), utni zyada power. Power lens ka SI unit dioptre (D) hai, aur formula P = 1/f (meter me). Jaise -2.0 D ka chashma matlab myopia ki sudhai, focus 0.5 m par. Meter length ka unit hai, watt power (energy/time) ka, joule energy ka - ye lens ki optical power ke liye nahi hain. Exam point: 'Lens power ka SI unit = dioptre (D = 1/f metre)'.
